changes: Replaced the separate Test the Software imitation with one-click guest access to SAGA's actual Teacher and Student pages.
Created a dedicated fictional college, class roster, assessments and grade records for the authentic read-only demo.
Demo sessions expire in 45 minutes and cannot modify any SAGA API; school and account permissions remain enforced.
Retained the original editable sample simulator under a clearly labeled optional Practice Simulator page.
Kept the demo school hidden from regular registration and added security regression checks. No Dean role was introduced.
Launched a public interactive Test the Software tour featuring Teacher, Student, and read-only Platform Administrator previews.
Teacher demo includes editable gradebook scores, attendance, grade visibility, and simulated submission states using fictional records.
Student demo includes sample grades and an isolated what-if score simulator; switching roles retains in-browser sample changes until reset.
Public demo data never invokes production authentication, grades, tenant management APIs, or Neon database writes.
Added responsive light and dark demo palettes, accessible navigation controls, and a landing-page entry point.
Teachers can now search and add registered, email-verified students from their own school directly to a class roster.
Teachers can generate, copy, rotate, or revoke seven-day class invitation codes for verified students.
Students can join an eligible class from their Student Portal using a teacher-provided invitation code and view their linked class list.
Enrollment now preserves existing attendance, assessment scores, and grade history when linking registered students to existing class records.
Added duplicate-enrollment, tenant-isolation, account-verification, and invitation-code protections.
The global copyright footer now follows the saved Light/Dark appearance setting on all portal and administration pages.
Teachers now have a calm navy-and-blue interface with warm highlights; students have a welcoming teal-and-sky palette, each with dark-mode alternatives.
Improved contrast for navigation, grade-summary cards, controls, and account preferences without changing academic status colors.
The footer stays aligned with the class sidebar on desktop, adapts to mobile screens, and remains hidden from printed grade reports.
Added a consistent copyright and release-version footer across SAGA, including a link to this version history.
Improved My Classes navigation: desktop hover opens the menu, while mobile uses tap-to-expand without selecting a class.
Added Student ID or email sign-in for registered students and Faculty IDs for teacher registration and profiles.
Added existing-school selection and a Not listed option to teacher signup.
Expanded Tenant Operations with school health, subscription follow-ups, verification totals, activity and payment reporting.
Improved student grade summaries, on-demand assessment details, grade simulation navigation and mobile layouts.
Optimized class records, workbook score saving, roster imports and attendance completion checks.
